summary: ELI LILLY AND COMPANY (LEI: FRDRIPF3EKNDJ2CQJL29) is identifier-confirmed, registered in Indiana, United States, with its identity corroborated across GLEIF, OpenCorporates, and Wikidata. GLEIF reports a GLEIF-level reporting exception at the parent level, indicating that ultimate ownership rests with one or more natural persons whose identities are not disclosed in the LEI record; this constitutes a medium-confidence opaque ownership signal requiring further CDD. The company holds direct accounting-consolidation relationships over at least six subsidiaries spanning the US, India, Ireland, and the Netherlands per GLEIF, and a broad set of officers is recorded across OpenCorporates and Wikidata, including David A. Ricks as CEO and board member from 2017 and Jonathan Haug as senior managing official from 2023. Two structural risk signals were raised: related party Katherine Baicker is a possible name match — unconfirmed by birth date or nationality — to a PEP record on OpenSanctions and an EveryPolitician political office-holder record (medium confidence each); and related party Patrik Jonsson is similarly a possible name match only to PEP records on OpenSanctions and EveryPolitician (medium confidence each); additionally, related party Christopher Anderson matches records in both the Panama Papers and the Paradise Papers (Appleby) at an ICIJ score of 100/100 (high confidence), though this is a name-level match against a common name and does not constitute a finding of wrongdoing. One material gap exists: Wikirate could not be queried due to a source API schema error, so any data that source would have contributed — including headquarters and website fields — is absent from this review.
